semantics: Strict plain detached immutable data; no getters/prototype/sparse/cyclic inputs or unknown keys.
Lookup exact relationshipId in pinned catalog; preserve source IDs and literature species namespace without minting app species IDs.
Missing applicability/support/possession stays UNKNOWN; NOT_APPLICABLE needs exact approved packet, never caller Boolean.
Preserve original capture/handoff/reference bytes and signed zero through native exact contracts; transport JSON digest does not prove native identity or authority.
Validate explicit assessment and exact candidate/static/context correspondence; no wall clock or latest/nearest source selection.
Native source admission, relationship approval and independent validation references must resolve through trusted future boundary, never digest or supplied qualification enum alone.
History AVAILABLE-empty requires successful declared-scope resolution; row cap/empty array is not coverage or sample sufficiency.
All catalog relationships remain candidates here; REFERENCE_BOUND_ONLY preserves references but authorizes no scientific execution.
Output reasons are structural limitations, never biological absence, adequacy, governed-zero, score, confidence or ranking permission.
negativeDesignCases: unknown vertical DO/depth and no surface proxy
later consumed represented/support time and unproven possession
same evidence repeated as independent history
DIRECT/GAP_FILLED pooling or product revision substitution
signed-zero or native source bytes changed by JSON transport

capturedReference.sha256: 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters; synthetic transport consistency only

namespace.sourceIds: Exact ordered bibliographic source_ids array of selected pinned relationship; no duplicates, no empty list
namespace.literatureSpeciesId: Exact register species_id; not runtime species ID
namespace.staticParentReferences: Ordered nonempty array of capturedReference, unique referenceId; no sorting or substitution
namespace.assessment: Exact existing requireScientificAssessmentV1 input: contractVersion and assessmentAt; no missing/default clock

applicability.knownRule: DECLARED_SYNTHETIC requires CONTROLLED_FIXTURE_ label and capturedReference, no scientific applicability established

inputEntry.arrayRule: Supplied ordered array, including empty; no claim that supplied slots are complete scientific requirements

precedence: Malformed/extra/private keys, wrong namespace/order/duplicate ID/version/catalog/candidate reference shape: throw fixed INVALID_SPECIES_REFERENCE_INPUT before output; never echo values.
Valid catalog classification UNSUPPORTED_IN_REVIEWED_CORPUS => UNSUPPORTED_CLAIM even when slots absent/unavailable.
Otherwise any ABSENT supplied slot => MISSING_REFERENCED_INPUT; means missing declared transport reference, not scientific required input.
Otherwise any LOOKUP_UNAVAILABLE supplied slot => LOOKUP_UNAVAILABLE; never substitute absent/empty or try I/O.
Otherwise REFERENCE_BOUND_ONLY; zero supplied slots remain structurally bound with EMPTY_DECLARED_INPUT_SET, not complete evidence.
All valid outputs authorityState UNRESOLVED_NOT_ADMITTED, byteIdentity NOT_VERIFIED; no source/approval lookup or qualified packet resolver exists in this scope.
referenceSchemaDesignV2.privacy: Closed exact schema; synthetic prefixed opaque IDs/labels only; no emails, bearer/session/owner IDs, coordinates, report bodies, free-form reasons/limitations, URLs or implicit dereferencing. Synthetic designation alone does not prove arbitrary supplied content safe; fixtures inspected and only fixed placeholders accepted in first packet.
referenceSchemaDesignV2.nativeVerification: This packet never parses/reencodes sample payloads or claims byte equality. Future separately authorized exact native material is validated by decodeScalarHandoff/decodeNormalizedCurrentHandoff and their existing capture/reference codecs with unchanged captureText/contextText bytes and Object.is(sourceValue,-0) checks; no ordinary JSON round-trip/digest substitutes for native identity, provider authenticity or cutoff possession.
referenceSchemaDesignV2.approvalValidation: Approval/source-admission/validation refs are intentionally excluded from v2 pure input; supplied fields are rejected. Future trusted resolver needs a distinct approved version and exact owned port; no inferred absent requirements or caller requiredByApprovedPacket/QUALIFIED enum.
